cumleler: Where do the two ears' signals first meet in the brain?
The auditory nerve first reaches the cochlear nucleus.
Up to this level, information belongs to only one ear.
Fibers then reach the superior olivary complex in the brainstem.
This is where information from the two ears first meets.
Here, time and level differences between the ears are compared.
